headline: Build Your 3-Watch Collection. $25K Total.
stop_reason: Not built. Research could not be completed: the retailer pages for the dress, field and diver picks (Tudor, Seiko, Nomos, Rolex) returned HTTP 429/403 when opened, so their prices could not be recorded in the browser trace. Only Cartier WSTA0106, Longines L2.793.4.78.3, Hamilton H69439931 and Omega 210.30.42.20.01.001 (plus Omega 210.30.42.20.03.004, a James Bond limited edition) were opened and confirmed. Each tier needs three verified options, so no carousel was made. The validator also rejects retailer pages as source_type, so research.json v2.0 and governance ledgers were not written. Retry when the retailer sites are reachable, or the owner can pick a different angle.
